name: Settings switches
summary: A group of on and off settings, each with a plain explanation, including one that is locked by the organization.
use: on a settings page with on and off options
a11y: Native checkboxes with role switch inside their labels, so the whole row is the target; the switch is at least 24 px tall; a setting the organization locked shows its state in words with a lock and is read as "On, locked".
